representedDate: Restored standing theatre documented by the theatre’s post-restoration publication. The 1875 photograph informs the enduring frontage, side openings and classical profile.
wholePhysicalScope: Exact native sides and ends of the neoclassical theatre with side recesses and a central square-facing three-arch portico.
lodDetails: All four levels retain the three open portico arches, seven central bays, balcony and hipped roof. Near levels add full side windows, portal trim and balusters, lower stairs and bronze lettering.
limitations: Wall and roof heights, window widths, the stage range and some side openings are estimated from mapped proportions, the archival elevation and written accounts.
The present exterior uses a warm off-white and cream finish based on the theatre publication and the mapped color. The adjoining Multipalco is outside the 1858 theatre scope.
